title: NEXT THING SMOKIN'
lyrics_plain:
(Intro) . . . .
Well I don't know where I'm goin',
and I don't even care.
When it comes tomorrow morning,
you won't find me anywhere.
I'll be gone... long gone.
You be callin' me back, girl
but I'll be makin' tracks,
baby I'm gone.
Baby I'm a leavin' on the next thing smokin'.
This time I'm gone and I ain't joking.
